<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_intro_title">Guide to pair a device from the remote device</string>

<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_intro_content">On some devices, Bluetooth visibility may be disabled, preventing them from being detected by the app. This guide will help you resolve the issue by explaining how to pair your devices directly from the remote device.</string>
<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_1_content_1">You must first enable Bluetooth visibility on this device.</string>
<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_1_content_2">This device should be visible to other devices under the name: %1$s.</string>

<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_2_content_2">- Open the Bluetooth settings.
- Select the option to pair a new device.
- The device "%1$s" should appear in the list of available devices.
- Select the device "%1$s" to initiate pairing.</string>

<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_2_content_3">A pairing confirmation request should appear on both devices. You must accept this request on both devices to complete the Bluetooth pairing.</string>
<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_2_content_4">If no confirmation request appears, restart Bluetooth on the remote device and repeat the previous steps.</string>

<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_3_content_1">If the pairing was successful, the Android device should automatically connect to the remote device. However, this connection does not use the HID (Human Interface Device) protocol, which prevents the remote control from working. To resolve this issue:</string>
<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_3_content_2">- Go to the Bluetooth settings on your device.\n- Manually disconnect the remote device.</string>

<string name="pairing_from_a_remote_device_step_4_content">If you have followed all the previous steps, the pairing was successful, and you have disconnected both devices, you can select the \"%1$s\" button. The remote device should appear in the list of paired devices. Select it to establish the connection using the HID protocol.</string>

<string name="help_info_message">If you experience any issues, please check the help section.</string>
<string name="help_info_hid_service_not_initialized_message">The HID service has not been initialized. Please consult the help section.</string>
<string name="help_select_device_from_list">Select the device you wish to connect with from the list of paired devices.</string>
<string name="help_missing_device_message">If the remote device does not appear in the list of paired devices, you need to pair it by pressing the icon in the top bar.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_message_1">If you\'re unable to connect to the remote device, please make sure to follow the instructions below:</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_check_1">• Ensure that the remote device operates on Android or Android TV.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_check_2">• Make sure that the Bluetooth function is enabled on the remote device.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_check_3">• Make sure that both devices are close enough to each other.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_message_2">If despite these checks you still cannot connect to the remote device, proceed as follows:</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_check_5">• Unpair the two devices, both on the current device and on the remote device.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_check_6">• Re-pair the two devices by pressing the icon located in the top bar.</string>
<string name="help_device_failed_connection_message_3">If the problem persists, ensure that the Bluetooth sensor of your devices is not defective.</string>
<string name="help_paring_select_device_from_list">Select the device you want to pair with from the list of available devices.</string>
<string name="help_pairing_missing_device_message_1">If the device you wish to pair with does not appear, follow the instructions below:</string>
<string name="help_pairing_missing_device_check_2">• Ensure that Bluetooth visibility is enabled on the remote device.</string>
<string name="help_pairing_missing_device_check_location_for_android_11_or_less">• Ensure that location services are enabled on your device.</string>
<string name="help_pairing_connection_initialization_error_message_1">If you have successfully paired both devices but encounter errors \"%1$s\" or \"%2$s\":</string>

<string name="help_pairing_device_failed_connection_message_1">If you have successfully paired both devices but are unable to connect to the remote device, please make sure to follow the instructions below:</string>
<string name="help_remote_control_buttons_are_not_working_message">If the keyboard, mouse, or certain buttons are not functioning, follow the instructions below:</string>
<string name="help_remote_control_buttons_are_not_working_check_3">• Unpair the devices, on both this device and the remote device.</string>
<string name="help_remote_control_buttons_are_not_working_check_4">• Then, re-pair the two devices using this application.</string>

<string name="help_remote_control_buttons_are_not_working_message_2">Each application using the HID protocol may rely on a different profile. If you have previously paired your devices through another application, you might need to re-pair them to reset the profile. Without this step, the buttons may not function as expected or might send incorrect values.</string>

<string name="help_keyboard_wrong_character_sent_message">If the characters being sent are incorrect, you need to configure the physical keyboard on the remote device to match the language selected in the application settings.</string>

<string name="help_hid_service_not_initialized_message_1">If a message indicates that the HID service has not been initialized, please go to your device\'s developer options and look for the option \"Disable Bluetooth HID Device Profile\":</string>
<string name="help_hid_service_not_initialized_message_2">• If this option is available, disable it, then restart your device. After restarting, the HID profile should function normally.</string>

<string name="help_hid_service_not_initialized_message_3">• If this option is not available, your device may not support the HID profile. In that case, unfortunately, you won\'t be able to use this application on this device.</string>
